description: Production List answers questions about film and television productions from a live directory of 12,000+ titles published by the Film & Television Industry Alliance. Ask what is filming in a city right now, whether a title has started shooting, which companies and people are attached to it, who is casting it, or what a production company is working on. Every answer links the production's public page and states when it was last updated. The plugin returns public listing facts only; it never returns personal contact details, which are available to Production List members.

defaultPrompt: What's filming in Atlanta right now?
Who is casting the new season of Daredevil: Born Again?
